Why It Matters

An invisible risk. A very real cost.

A discharge you cannot feel can still damage sensitive components. A complete ESD program protects people, surfaces and packaging together.

Ground the person

Wrist straps, heel grounders, aprons and gloves keep operators at safe potential.

Control the workstation

Mats, chairs, tweezers and meters keep every surface dissipative and verified.

Protect in transit

ESD packaging and consumables guard product from line to customer.
